title: KUDEX: A Zero-Shot Decompositional Framework for Logical Analysis in Natural Language
abstract: arXiv:2611.18851v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at generating fluent text, they often struggle with multi-step logical reasoning with inferential connections among statements. We introduce KUDEX (Knowledge-Upward-Downward Reasoning Extension), a novel zero-shot, decompositional framework for analyzing and verifying logical relationships in natural language. Unlike traditional approaches that rely on surface-level entailment checks, KUDEX leverages LLMs to decompose reasoning into atomic primitives and constructs transparent reasoning graphs that serve both as execution traces and audit logs. Our framework includes a general prompt adaptation pipeline that adapts to diverse reasoning tasks without additional fine-tuning or domain-specific pipelines. translated_title: KUDEX：一种面向自然语言逻辑分析的零样本分解式框架
translated_abstract: 虽然大型语言模型（LLMs）擅长生成流畅的文本，但它们在处理涉及语句间推理关联的多步逻辑推理时往往表现不佳。我们提出了KUDEX（Knowledge-Upward-Downward Reasoning Extension，知识向上向下推理扩展），这是一种新颖的零样本分解式框架，用于分析和验证自然语言中的逻辑关系。与依赖表面蕴含检查的传统方法不同，KUDEX利用LLM将推理分解为原子原语，并构建透明的推理图，这些推理图既可作为执行轨迹，也可作为审计日志。我们的框架包含一个通用的提示词适配管线，无需额外的微调或领域特定管线即可适应多样化的推理任务。通过在四个领域基准测试上的全面实验，我们证明KUDEX相比现有方法具有更优越的性能，提供了一个更细粒度、更稳健的框架。
tldr: KUDEX是一种零样本分解式框架，通过将推理分解为原子原语并构建可审计的透明推理图来验证自然语言中的逻辑关系，无需微调即可在四个领域的基准测试中超越现有方法。
en_tdlr: KUDEX is a zero-shot decompositional framework that analyzes and verifies logical relationships in natural language by decomposing reasoning into atomic primitives and constructing transparent, auditable reasoning graphs, outperforming existing methods across four domain benchmarks without fine-tuning.
